name: Gearbox
text: Add Anthropic’s Claude 3.7 Sonnet to EXCAVA’s toolkit as the default high-speed reasoning engine. It’s the strongest general-purpose model available today, with a 200K token context window and native tool use—perfect for digesting large inputs and spitting out clean outputs without extra glue code. The trade-off is cost: it’s pricier than Llama 3.3, but the jump in output quality justifies the spend for tasks where precision beats pennies.

name: Torque
text: Mistral Large 2’s "slightly weaker creative output" is a red flag—EXCAVA’s core tasks aren’t creative writing, they’re precision-driven. The real risk is mistaking open-weight flexibility for reliability; Llama 3.3 70B already proved stable in blind tests, so the bake-off should compare it head-to-head with Mistral on EXCAVA’s exact failure modes, not just token counts.
